item.title: Building reliable agentic AI systems
item.description:
📝 Building Reliable Agentic AI Systems A Case Study in building production-ready agentic AI systems This paper presents the Preclinical Information Center (PRINCE), a cloud-hosted platform developed by Bayer AG with Thoughtworks to address pharmaceutical industry challenges in drug development. This approach holds the potential to revolutionize preclinical data access, enabling researchers to pose complex questions in natural language and receive accurate, context-rich answers grounded in proprietary data. This case study explores the technical architecture, engineering decisions, and lessons learned in transforming preclinical data retrieval from a challenging maze into an intuitive conversational experience.
🔗 Read more: https://martinfowler.com/articles/reliable-llm-bayer.html

item.title: Your brain was never designed for this much bad news
item.description:
📝 The brain that paid attention to threats was the brain that survived. Recent studies suggest people around the world demonstrate measurably stronger physiological responses to negative news than to positive news. For minority populations, news fatigue may be even more consequential.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/06/260614012006.htm
